original_ai_output.title_zh: 拉各斯加强埃博拉监测并呼吁民众保持冷静
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚拉各斯州政府加强疾病监测与防范措施，以预防、发现和应对潜在的埃博拉病毒病病例，并呼吁居民保持冷静。此前阿布贾联邦首都区确认一例从本迪布焦输入的埃博拉病例。州政府正加强入境点监测，尤其是穆尔塔拉·穆罕默德国际机场。

location.site: 穆尔塔拉·穆罕默德国际机场
location.raw_text: Lagos State, Murtala Muhammed International Airport (MMIA)

key_facts.fact: 拉各斯州政府加强埃博拉监测与防范措施
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Lagos State Government has intensified disease surveillance and strengthened its preparedness measures to prevent, detect, and respond to potential Ebola Virus Disease cases

key_facts.fact: 阿布贾联邦首都区确认一例从本迪布焦输入的埃博拉病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: because of the confirmation of an imported case of Ebola virus from Bundibugyo into the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Abuja

key_facts.fact: 州政府正加强入境点监测，尤其是穆尔塔拉·穆罕默德国际机场
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: collaboration with relevant agencies at points of entry, particularly the Murtala Muhammed International Airport (MMIA)

key_facts.fact: 卫生专员呼吁居民保持冷静、警惕并遵守预防措施
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: urging residents to remain calm, vigilant and adhere to recommended preventive measures

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
拉各斯州是否存在疑似病例尚未证实
